sentences.en: My favorite scene from the entire show is when Michael gives Oscar the scarecrow and then Michael's talking head afterwards where he is laughing.

sentences.en: I got to tell you about my dad.
sentences.zh: 我得跟你讲讲我爸的事。

sentences.en: So my dad is very, very foundational in my comedy writing career.
sentences.zh: 我父亲对我喜剧写作生涯的奠基作用非常非常大。

sentences.en: And, like, my biggest break was writing a Seinfeld episode.
sentences.zh: 我职业生涯最大的突破就是写了一集《宋飞正传》。

sentences.en: And it was all basically the story of something that happened to my dad in New York where he was trying to park his car.
sentences.zh: 那集故事基本上就是我爸在纽约停车时发生的事。

sentences.en: And he pulls it.
sentences.zh: 他当时正要把车停进去。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The parking space episode where he pulls it.
sentences.zh: 就是那一集，他正要停进车位。

sentences.en: He backs into a space.
sentences.zh: 他倒车入库。

sentences.en: And someone's pulling it.
sentences.zh: 然后有人也要抢那个车位。

sentences.en: Oh, I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 噢，我之前不知道。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That happened to my dad.
sentences.zh: 那事儿发生在我爸身上。

sentences.en: And he was so stubborn because he'd been trying to find a parking space for, like, 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他当时特别固执，因为他已经找了45分钟车位了。

sentences.en: And he just sat in his car.
sentences.zh: 他就坐在车里不走。

sentences.en: And the other guy wouldn't budge either.
sentences.zh: 对方也不肯让步。

sentences.en: And then my dad saw a friend of his walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 然后我爸看到他一个朋友正走在街上。

sentences.en: And he shouted out to him, my wife, Howard, bring me dinner.
sentences.zh: 他就冲那人喊：嘿，霍华德，给我带份晚饭来。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was just like this really funny sort of New York-y conflict.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那真是一种非常有纽约特色的滑稽冲突。

sentences.en: Anyway, so I wrote that up.
sentences.zh: 总之，我就把这事写下来了。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of little references to my dad over the series.
sentences.zh: 整部剧里还有很多关于我爸的小彩蛋。

sentences.en: So, for instance, in, I guess, the first Dundies, when Michael puts on a Karnak turban and does a joke about health care, who has better health care, the PLO or, you know.

sentences.en: That was a joke I wrote for my dad's comedy routine that he used to do in his company.
sentences.zh: 那个笑话是我为我爸写的，他以前在公司表演时经常用。

sentences.en: He used to put on his turban and do a Karnak routine.
sentences.zh: 他以前会戴上头巾表演卡纳克节目。

sentences.en: Like Johnny Carson bits?
sentences.zh: 就像约翰尼·卡森的那些段子吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He would do the Johnny Carson thing.
sentences.zh: 他会模仿约翰尼·卡森。

sentences.en: And he had a sidekick.
sentences.zh: 他还有一个搭档。

sentences.en: And I would write for him.
sentences.zh: 我会为他写段子。

sentences.en: And he used to do this every year at the management meeting of his company.
sentences.zh: 他每年在公司管理层会议上都会表演这个。

sentences.en: How old were you when you first wrote, like, a bit for him?
sentences.zh: 你第一次为他写段子时多大？

sentences.en: Like, 14 or something.
sentences.zh: 大概14岁左右吧。

sentences.en: And so I used – but that was the exact joke.
sentences.zh: 所以我用的是……那就是那个原版笑话。

sentences.en: The one that's in the Dundies was the exact joke that I used for my first joke for my dad that went over really well in his company.
sentences.zh: 《邓迪奖》里的那个笑话，就是我当年为我爸写的第一个笑话，当时在他公司反响特别好。

sentences.en: And there's other things in here.
sentences.zh: 剧里还有其他东西。

sentences.en: For instance, in the company, my dad was a salesman in this company at one point.

sentences.en: And he had a friend.
sentences.zh: 他有个朋友。

sentences.zh: 所以我把这个桥段放进了销售拜访的戏份里。

sentences.zh: 就是当安吉洛试图搞清楚他们的搭档套路是什么的时候。

sentences.zh: 他们会联手对付这些人，你知道的，试图博取大家对那个装了金属板的人的同情。

sentences.en: And, yeah, so there's a lot in there.

sentences.en: But one of the things that my dad does that to me is the most likable thing that he does is he gets on these runs where he's making himself crack up.

sentences.en: So this was like a total moment of overlap for me is seeing this thing that, you know, my dad would do coming out of Steve so brilliantly who, you know, knew my dad.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我来说是一个完全重叠的时刻，看到我爸会做的事，竟然从史蒂夫身上如此精彩地展现出来，而史蒂夫是认识我爸的。

sentences.zh: 他纠正了她，对吧？

sentences.en: So between Steve and Oscar Nunez, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以史蒂夫和奥斯卡·努涅斯之间，我也不知道。

sentences.zh: 每当我听到这样的故事，无论是你写的，还是我们任何编剧写的，

sentences.en: how it relates back to their life is just my favorite thing to hear.

sentences.zh: 所以一切都得是，你是怎么想出那个点子的？

sentences.en: I love it.

sentences.en: Well, now Michael is going to approach Angela Martin.

sentences.en: And I talked about this a little bit earlier.
sentences.zh: 我刚才稍微提过这一点。

sentences.en: If you go to 9 minutes and 51 seconds, you can see that my eyes are bright red.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到9分51秒，你会发现我的眼睛红得发亮。

sentences.zh: 真的，全红了。

sentences.en: Angela, Paul Feig said he had to call for makeup to give you eye drops to take the red out.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，保罗·费格说他不得不叫化妆师给你滴眼药水来消除红血丝。

sentences.en: Because you wouldn't stop crying.
sentences.zh: 因为你哭个不停。

sentences.en: And your eyes were so red.
sentences.zh: 而且你的眼睛太红了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Well, during this scene, you're going to show the pictures of your time with the senator and his super hot aide, Thomas.
sentences.zh: 在这场戏里，你要展示你和参议员以及他那个超级帅的助手托马斯在一起的照片。

sentences.en: Is this the first part – is this the first hint that we have of the aide and the senator or is that earlier?
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次暗示助手和参议员的关系吗，还是说之前就有过？

sentences.en: I feel like you had one comment about his aide earlier.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你之前好像评论过他的助手。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Didn't he join you for Valentine's Day or something?
sentences.zh: 他不是情人节那天和你一起参加活动还是什么的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Actually, it might have been in deleted scenes, but I shared it that everyone talks about how they're going to spend their Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 其实，那段可能是在删减片段里，但我分享过大家都在讨论情人节打算怎么过的内容。

sentences.en: And Angela has a talking head where she was like, the senator's taking me out somewhere.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉有个采访镜头，她说参议员要带她去什么地方。

sentences.en: But then he has to leave early to meet his aide, Thomas.
sentences.zh: 但后来他得早走去见他的助手托马斯。

sentences.en: To do a little work.
sentences.zh: 去处理点工作。

sentences.en: They do a lot of late-night work sessions.
sentences.zh: 他们经常有深夜工作会议。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, Randy shared with us that these pictures were not shot on a green screen.
sentences.zh: 兰迪跟我们分享过，这些照片并不是在绿幕前拍的。

sentences.en: You actually went to an antique shop, and you went to a nearby street to go rollerblading to shoot those photos.
sentences.zh: 你们真的去了古董店，还去了附近的街道滑旱冰来拍那些照片。

sentences.en: Do you remember that, Ange?
sentences.zh: 安吉，你还记得吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: We sort of did it all in one day, and we drove to a few different places.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上是一天之内搞定的，开车去了好几个不同的地方。

sentences.en: And I was most excited about rollerblading because I love to roller skate.
sentences.zh: 我最兴奋的就是滑旱冰，因为我特别喜欢溜冰。

sentences.en: And so I was very excited that my character got to do anything other than just sit in a corner and scowl.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴我的角色终于能做点除了坐在角落里皱眉头以外的事了。

sentences.en: But rollerblading is very different than roller skating.
sentences.zh: 但滑旱冰和溜冰其实很不一样。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Can you do both?
sentences.zh: 你两种都会吗？

sentences.en: I can do both.
sentences.zh: 我两种都会。

sentences.en: I prefer roller skating.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢溜冰。

sentences.en: But I was just excited to be outside and skate, and I got to wear shorts.
sentences.zh: 但我当时只是很兴奋能到户外去滑，而且我还能穿短裤。

sentences.en: And I got a day where I got to travel around the valley.
sentences.zh: 那天我还有机会在山谷里到处转转。

sentences.en: Antiquing and rollerblading.
sentences.zh: 逛古董店和滑旱冰。

sentences.en: Antiquing and rollerblading.
sentences.zh: 逛古董店和滑旱冰。

sentences.en: It was really fun.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: So we have failed to mention D'Angelo's struggle in this episode, which is that he is being very tempted by all the snacks in the vending machine.
sentences.zh: 我们还没提到这一集里迪安杰洛的挣扎，就是他被自动售货机里的各种零食诱惑得不行。

sentences.en: We're going to see him in the break room now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要去休息室看看他。

sentences.en: And he is making a s'more on the heating pad of the coffee maker.
sentences.zh: 他正在咖啡机的加热垫上做烤棉花糖夹心饼干。

sentences.en: And Andy is going to come in and say he needs some help with a client.
sentences.zh: 安迪一会儿会进来，说他需要帮忙处理一个客户。

sentences.en: Greg, have you done this?
sentences.zh: 格雷格，你做过这种事吗？

sentences.en: Have you made a s'more, like, in a microwave or something?
sentences.zh: 比如用微波炉或者什么东西做过烤棉花糖夹心饼干？

sentences.en: I feel like this is something you would do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这像是你会做的事。

sentences.en: Because I have been in the kitchen with you where you're like, we only had a few ingredients of something, and maybe we didn't have all the right utensils.
sentences.zh: 因为我和你在厨房待过，当时你说，我们只有几种配料，可能也没有合适的餐具。

sentences.en: You're like, let's try it.
sentences.zh: 你就说，咱们试试吧。

sentences.en: Well, I went to boarding school, and so a lot of times, you know, if you couldn't cook, you had no access to the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我上过寄宿学校，很多时候，如果你不会做饭，又没法进厨房。

sentences.en: And so sometimes you have to, like, make up stuff that you could do with one of those little coils that heats up.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候你不得不利用那种加热线圈来搞点发明创造。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, so if there was any –
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以如果有任何——

sentences.en: Grilled cheese with an iron, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 用熨斗做烤芝士三明治，就是那种事。

sentences.en: Yeah, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 对，就是那种。

sentences.en: Well, we had a fan catch from Madison M.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自科罗拉多州丹佛市麦迪逊·M的粉丝发现，在这一集里，我得先说一句，麦迪逊是对的。

sentences.en: in Denver, Colorado in this episode, and I'm going to just say ahead of time, Madison is correct.
sentences.zh: 麦迪逊说，我注意到了这一集里的一个连贯性错误。

sentences.en: Madison said, I noticed a continuity error in this episode.
sentences.zh: 在10分40秒时，迪安杰洛正在用咖啡壶做棉花糖巧克力点心。

sentences.en: At 10 minutes and 40 seconds, D'Angelo is cooking the marshmallow chocolate treat with the coffee pot.
sentences.zh: 安迪走进来，在10分51秒时，他用左手把它扔进了垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Andy walks in, and at 10 minutes and 51 seconds, he throws it in the garbage with his left hand.
sentences.zh: 但在11分钟时，当他拍打门框上方并留下巧克力指纹时，用的是右手。

sentences.en: But at 11 minutes, when he slaps the top of the doorway and leaves chocolate fingerprints, it's with his right hand.
sentences.zh: 真是个不错的发现。

sentences.en: That's a nice catch.
sentences.zh: 发现得真好。

sentences.en: That's a good catch.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's possible he had chocolate all over himself, but that's a good catch.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他身上沾满巧克力是有可能的，但你观察得真仔细。

sentences.en: I remember that chocolate fingerprint hand being up there for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个巧克力指纹手印在那儿待了很久。

sentences.en: I'm eager now to watch it and try to spot it every time.
sentences.zh: 我现在很想回去看一遍，试着每次都把它找出来。

sentences.en: When was it ever cleaned off?
sentences.zh: 它到底是什么时候被清理掉的？

sentences.en: I don't know if it ever was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它有没有被清理过。

sentences.en: I mean, it might be there till the end.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它可能一直都在那儿，直到最后。

sentences.en: I don't know, but I feel like it's definitely above my head when I'm doing the fake juggling in the break room
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但我感觉当我做那个假杂耍的时候，它肯定就在我头顶上方，就在休息室里，

sentences.en: in D'Angelo's last episode.
sentences.zh: 在迪安杰洛的最后一集里。

sentences.en: Can I tell a quick story about The Simpsons?
sentences.zh: 我能讲个关于《辛普森一家》的短故事吗？

sentences.en: Yes, please.
sentences.zh: 好啊，请讲。

sentences.en: No, nobody wants stories about The Simpsons.
sentences.zh: 不，没人想听关于《辛普森一家》的故事。

sentences.en: When I joined the writing staff on The Simpsons, which was the end of season four,
sentences.zh: 当我加入《辛普森一家》编剧组时，那是第四季末尾，

sentences.en: in the writer's room, there was this weird brown object stuck to the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 在编剧室的天花板上粘着一个奇怪的棕色物体。

sentences.en: And it turned out that somebody had chewed up a bunch of caramels, stuck it on a doll of Bart,
sentences.zh: 后来发现是有人嚼了一堆焦糖，把它粘在一个巴特玩偶上，

sentences.en: on his spiky hair, and stuck him to the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 粘在他那尖尖的头发上，然后把他贴到了天花板上。

sentences.en: And then that was like a little room bit for a while.
sentences.zh: 那段时间这成了房间里的一个小梗。

sentences.en: And then the doll fell off, and the caramels were there.
sentences.zh: 后来玩偶掉了下来，但焦糖还留在上面。

sentences.en: And this was like two years old by the time I got there.
sentences.zh: 等我到那儿的时候，这东西都已经在那儿两年了。

sentences.en: And they were like, oh, yes, I'll tell you the story about the caramels in the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 他们当时说，哦，对了，我给你讲讲天花板上焦糖的故事。

sentences.en: It's just hard.
sentences.zh: 这事儿挺难办的。

sentences.en: And I was like, yeah, why doesn't anybody clean it up?
sentences.zh: 我就问，是啊，为什么没人把它清理掉呢？

sentences.en: But, yeah, those kind of things will last sometimes in an office.
sentences.zh: 不过，是啊，这种东西在办公室里有时确实会留很久。

sentences.en: Like the chocolate fingerprints could be there two years later.
sentences.zh: 就像那个巧克力指纹，两年后可能还在那儿。

sentences.en: People are like, oh, yeah, that was the time that it was.
sentences.zh: 大家会说，哦，对，就是那次留下的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It just lives there now.
sentences.zh: 它现在就成了那儿的一部分了。

sentences.en: I feel like I have those things in my house.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我家里也有这种东西。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm like, oh, yeah, that was a kid's.
sentences.zh: 我感觉就像是，哦，对，那是孩子留下的。

sentences.en: You become blind to stuff in your house.
sentences.zh: 你会对家里的东西视而不见。

sentences.en: No, I mean, like, I feel like we have, like, here's a perfect example.
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，我觉得我们有，比如，这儿有个完美的例子。

sentences.en: One year for Halloween, we put, like, handprints and footprints on the gate, you know, the side gate of our house.
sentences.zh: 有一年万圣节，我们在大门上，就是我们家侧门，贴了手印和脚印，你知道的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: They were like a path, you know, like a scary path.
sentences.zh: 它们就像一条路，你知道，一条恐怖小径。

sentences.en: And when we peeled them off, part of them remained.
sentences.zh: 当我们把它们撕下来时，有一部分还留着。

sentences.en: They didn't peel off exactly, and, like, part of the sticky's there.
sentences.zh: 它们没能完全撕下来，胶印还留在那儿。

sentences.en: Oh, I see.
sentences.zh: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.en: And now they just live there.
sentences.zh: 现在它们就一直待在那儿了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You get completely blind to the stuff in your environment.
sentences.zh: 你会对周围环境里的东西完全视而不见。

sentences.en: Like, I'm sure that somewhere in my house there's a list of things that a dog who died, like, six years ago can't eat or whatever.
sentences.zh: 就像我肯定我家里某处还贴着一张清单，上面写着那只六年前去世的狗不能吃什么之类的东西。

sentences.en: It's just still in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 它就还在厨房里。

sentences.en: It's taped up.
sentences.zh: 贴在墙上。

sentences.en: Do not feed this dog who no longer is with us.
sentences.zh: 不要喂这只已经不在我们身边的狗。

sentences.en: No chicken.
sentences.zh: 不能吃鸡肉。

sentences.en: The worst thing you can do is get out a magic eraser and start, like, erasering part of some handprints on your wall because then all you see is, like, how smudgy your walls are.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的事情就是你拿出魔力擦，开始擦墙上的手印，因为那样你只会看到你的墙有多脏。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's life with kids.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这就是有孩子的生活。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a hole I went down recently.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我最近就陷入了这个怪圈。

sentences.en: Well, Oscar is going to ask Michael where he should send his last paycheck.
sentences.zh: 好吧，奥斯卡要问迈克尔他的最后一张工资支票该寄到哪儿。

sentences.en: And everything hits Michael.
sentences.zh: 而迈克尔对此毫无头绪。

sentences.en: He doesn't even know his address.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不知道自己的地址。

sentences.en: It's real.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: He said, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不知道。

sentences.en: I live in Mountain Tun, you know, and he starts to freak out.
sentences.zh: 我说我住在山屯，你知道的，然后他就开始抓狂了。

sentences.en: And then he goes into the break room, and everyone is just hanging out and just eating and having a normal day.
sentences.zh: 接着他走进休息室，大家都在那儿闲聊、吃东西，过着平常的一天。

sentences.en: And he's sitting in the corner, and he's just becoming more and more emotional.
sentences.zh: 他坐在角落里，情绪变得越来越激动。

sentences.en: Yeah, Pam's talking about how she's going to have to buy a new shredder because the last one broke.
sentences.zh: 是啊，帕姆在说她得买台新碎纸机，因为旧的那台坏了。

sentences.en: I love it that Kevin's like, buy one that shreds magazines.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢凯文说的那句，买台能碎杂志的。

sentences.en: Yeah, why is he so fixated on shredding magazines?
sentences.zh: 是啊，他为什么那么执着于碎杂志？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: He clearly broke the shredder.
sentences.zh: 显然是他把碎纸机弄坏了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: She's like, Kevin, none of them shred magazines.
sentences.zh: 帕姆就说，凯文，没哪台碎纸机能碎杂志。

sentences.en: And then Jim is like, Kevin, did you break the last shredder?
sentences.zh: 然后吉姆就问，凯文，是不是你弄坏了上一台碎纸机？

sentences.en: These are such like real fly-on-the-wall office conversations.
sentences.zh: 这些对话听起来就像办公室里真实的偷听片段。

sentences.en: I feel like I love them.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我超爱这些对话。

sentences.en: Well, that's what I loved also about this episode is he's leaving, and there's so much opportunity for really mundane moments to hit him emotionally.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这也是我喜欢这一集的原因，他要走了，那些平凡的瞬间对他而言都变得感伤起来。

sentences.en: Like at the very, very end when he looks back, and it's just, you know, the typical sounds of the office is he's about to leave, and he's the only one who knows he's leaving.
sentences.zh: 就像最后他回头看的时候，在他即将离开时，办公室里传来了熟悉的声音，而他是唯一一个知道自己要走的人。

sentences.en: But this is another one of those moments where he's just overhearing this chitter-chatter, and yet it's also setting up Pam's lie that's going to get her out of the office later.
sentences.zh: 但这又是那种他无意中听到闲聊的时刻，同时也为帕姆后来离开办公室所编的谎言做了铺垫。

sentences.en: Yeah, but it's so true.
sentences.zh: 是啊，太真实了。

sentences.en: When you have to say goodbye to something that means a lot to you, I even remember, you know, when we were writing our book, and I went back, and I re-watched the finale,
sentences.zh: 当你不得不向对自己意义重大的事物告别时，我甚至记得，我们在写书的时候，我回去重看了大结局，

sentences.en: and kind of reliving that last week, and everything became big.
sentences.zh: 重温了最后那一周，一切都变得意义非凡。

sentences.en: I'm like, this is the last hot snack.
